title: Poisoned (Condition)
html:
This page is about the condition. For the condition type, see Poisoned (condition type). For the items, see Coatings.

Poisoned

  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.

 Poisoned

Properties

 Stack ID: POISONED

 Status groups: SG_Surface, SG_Poisoned, SG_Condition

 More properties:
  • InitiateCombat

Notes

  • A  Cup of Oil can be drunk to inflict the almost identical condition of  Oily Sup.
  • All rotten consumables will inflict this condition when consumed, making them a reliable source of triggering Aspect of the Beast: Honey Badger's passive ability.

Conditions with the same stack ID

Conditions with the stack ID POISONED, only one of these can be applied at the same time:
Condition Effects
Assassin's Blood
  • Creature must succeed a Constitution  Saving Throw or take 1d12⁠⁠Poison and get Poisoned until the next Long Rest.
  • On a successful save, it still takes half damage.
Noxious Fumes
  • Affected entity takes 1d4⁠⁠Poison each turn. It must succeed a  DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw or take an additional 2d4⁠⁠Poison, taking half damage in a success.
Poisoned
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
Poisonous Fumes
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Poison damage per turn.
  • Suffers  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
Sickly
  • Feeling extremely off - suspiciously so.
